One-line source footnote for a table, figure or listing

Source: R/source_note.R
source_note.Rd

Names the runs, and their project files, that produced the plot or table data files behind a table, figure or listing (TFL), so the TFL can be traced back to its run IDs. Intended as a footnote. Each run appears once, in the order its first file appears in files. Project paths and the paths of files no run recorded are relative to the folder that holds the store where possible. A file no run recorded is listed as <file> (no run record). An empty files is an error.

Usage

source_note(files, store = default_store())

Arguments

files

Character vector. Paths to the plot or table data files the TFL was made from.

store

Character scalar. The run store directory (see default_store()). Defaults to default_store(). Nothing is written to it.

Value

A character scalar such as "Source: theoph/theoph.mlxtran (run 20260101T120000Z-ab12)".

Details

A warning lists every file whose current state is not "unchanged" or "unchanged_late" (see check_output_files()), with its status, so a footnote is not trusted for files that were edited, deleted or never recorded.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
note <- source_note(c("theoph/theoph/summary.txt"))
ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(time, conc)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::labs(caption = note)
} # }
